prompt: A savage drowned horror stalking forward toward the viewer, full-length, gaunt and far too tall, spine hunched like a predator about to pounce, knees bent, long arms raised and spread with hooked black-nailed fingers dripping fresh red blood. Its whole head is bound tight in a filthy burlap sack soaked dark red with blood, cinched at the neck with barbed fishing wire; the cloth is blank, no face shows at all. Grey-blue drowned skin torn open in deep wounds, blood running down the chest and arms, a butcher's leather apron spattered with blood over torn fisherman's rags, rusted fish hooks pierced through the skin, bare blackened feet. Realistic oil-painted figure with smooth tonal shading and no outlines, lit dimly from the lower front by warm lantern light, deep shadow above. Whole figure in frame with margin all round. Plain flat solid magenta background, nothing else behind the subject.
